build:
CROSS=x86_64-w64-mingw32-
    TARGET_SYS=Windows
    BUILDMODE=static
    FILE_T=luajit.exe
    CFLAGS='-DUNICODE'
    XCFLAGS='-DLUAJIT_ENABLE_LUA52COMPAT '
    PREFIX={prefix} Q=
install:
CROSS=x86_64-w64-mingw32-
    TARGET_SYS=Windows
    BUILDMODE=static
    FILE_T=luajit.exe
    CFLAGS='-DUNICODE'
    XCFLAGS='-DLUAJIT_ENABLE_LUA52COMPAT '
    PREFIX={prefix} Q=

build:
CFLAGS='-UHAVE_READLINE' LIBREADLINE=''
CC=x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc
AR=x86_64-w64-mingw32-ar
RANLIB=x86_64-w64-mingw32-ranlib
OUT={build}/packages/mujs-prefix/src/mujs-build
prefix={prefix}
host=mingw
install:
CFLAGS='-UHAVE_READLINE' LIBREADLINE=''
CC=x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc
AR=x86_64-w64-mingw32-ar
RANLIB=x86_64-w64-mingw32-ranlib
OUT={build}/packages/mujs-prefix/src/mujs-build
prefix={prefix}
host=mingw
